critical_code_review_comments: EnterprisePortal.jsx (409 lines) — file is approaching the 700-line threshold but still under. Not urgent, but as more team-mgmt features get added, consider extracting SeatEditor modal + StatCard + Member row into /components/enterprise/ modules.

HeroBlobs.jsx configs object hardcodes 3-4 blob positions per variant with pixel offsets. On < 768px viewports these positions overflow the container in unexpected ways because the blobs are absolute-positioned with fixed px values, and only the outer section has overflow-hidden. For MVP it's fine but a responsive scale factor (or vw-based sizing) would harden mobile hero rendering.

assessment_router.py /certificates/{id}/pdf endpoint is publicly accessible (no auth) with a short opaque id — combined with /verify/{id} being public, this is a scraping vector. Fine if the platform intends credentials to be publicly verifiable+downloadable, but worth flagging for a future rate-limit or CAPTCHA layer.

Kicker uppercase rule: the source JSX writes 'Public Verification Portal' and CSS applies text-transform:uppercase via .section-kicker. Confirmed working — but note that if a translator ever localises these labels, the CSS uppercase will apply to non-Latin scripts too. Consider a data-attribute pattern for i18n safety.

verify/certifications/pricing hero markup pattern is now duplicated across 4+ pages (Verify.jsx, Certifications.jsx, Pricing.jsx, EnterprisePortal.jsx). Extract to a <HeroSection kicker= title= italic= variant=/> component to DRY up and to make the italic-accent + kicker pattern authoritative.
